One case where the discovered service type may not be the same as the requested service type is when using subtypes: The client may want to browse for only those ftp servers that allow anonymous connections. The client will pass the string “_ftp._tcp,_anon” to [`DNSServiceBrowse(_:_:_:_:_:_:_:)`](dnsservicebrowse(_:_:_:_:_:_:_:).md), but the type of the service that’s discovered is simply “_ftp._tcp”.
